changelog:
SHANEX Print Manager Pro V5.3.0

- Added animated file importing banner, per-file PDF validation indicators, and real-time WhatsApp Download Queue progress bar with expandable queue inspector.
- Automatically fall back to high-DPI lossless PNG rasterization for mixed vector + bitmap PDF pages instead of aborting under vector-preservation policy.
- Enhanced Backup DB Folder & Fresh Start to wipe all WhatsApp/browser caches, force-allow recovery when busy, rebuild and verify all SQLite tables/indexes, and prompt separately before cleaning downloads.
